Summary.Title: Life-Sciences Assurance Environment Register
Summary.AssuranceDecisionRule: Platform B and Platform B1 may evaluate assurance state. Qualified humans and authorized organizational roles remain responsible for binding decisions.
Summary.SourceOfTruthRule: Official records remain in governed source systems.
Summary.Step151Statement: Step 151 is a life-sciences assurance environment register. It does not prove implementation, production readiness, regulatory validation, or operational release.
Summary.Step152Gate: READY AFTER STEP 151 ENVIRONMENT REGISTER REVIEW

Environments.PrimaryAssuranceProblem: Clinical workflows may appear complete while identity, protocol, site, consent, delegation, data provenance, review, and evidence dependencies remain incomplete or inconsistent.
Environments.KeyWorkflowDependencies: Participant identity; informed consent; protocol version; site activation; investigator delegation; randomization; EDC; CTMS; eTMF; safety reporting; laboratory results; data review; monitoring; and submission traceability.
Environments.EvidenceSources: Protocol records; consent evidence; delegation logs; EDC audit trails; CTMS milestones; eTMF documents; monitoring evidence; laboratory evidence; safety records; and human review records.
Environments.OfficialSourceSystems: EDC, CTMS, eTMF, IRT/RTSM, safety systems, laboratory systems, document management systems, and regulated clinical repositories.
Environments.HumanAuthority: Principal investigator, sponsor medical authority, clinical operations, data management, safety personnel, quality assurance, and authorized reviewers.
Environments.AssuranceOutcomes: Protocol-to-evidence traceability; participant identity integrity; delegation assurance; consent assurance; review completeness; workflow dependency integrity; and inspection reconstruction.
Environments.RepresentativeUseCases: Site activation readiness; enrollment admissibility; consent verification; clinical data provenance; protocol deviation reconstruction; AI-assisted trial decision governance; and inspection readiness.
Environments.PlatformAApplication: Registers the use case, regulated context, stakeholders, risk classification, system inventory, and governance ownership.
Environments.PlatformBv1Application: Uses the frozen six-capability Platform B v1 core for registry, assurance checks, evidence upload, trust scoring, admissibility records, and wearable endpoint simulation where applicable.
Environments.PlatformB1Application: Evaluates advanced assurance conditions such as evidence integrity, workflow dependency integrity, source agreement, identity, authority, No-Bind state, reconstruction, and inspection readiness.
Environments.ThreadCApplication: Translates verified lessons into Assurance Engineering doctrine, research, publications, teaching material, and regulated case studies.
Environments.ThreadDv1Application: May display or witness Platform B v1 assurance state through the locked Thread D v1 connector. It has no decision authority.
Environments.ThreadD2Application: May display Platform B1 evaluated assurance state through RAMAT Vision. It remains preview-only and DISPLAY / WITNESS ONLY.
Environments.CrossCuttingAssuranceOSApplication: Uses shared identity, evidence integrity, hashing, rehashing, chain-of-custody, authority, provenance, and governance schemas.
Environments.DecisionBoundary: Platform B or Platform B1 may evaluate assurance state. Qualified humans and authorized organizational roles make binding decisions.
Environments.DisplayBoundary: Thread D, Thread D2, RAMAT Vision, glasses, wearables, and device witnesses may display or witness state but may not approve, release, override, resolve, or execute regulated work.
Environments.SourceOfTruthBoundary: Official records remain in governed source systems. COBIT-Chain may reference, hash, seal, evaluate, reconstruct, or display evidence but does not replace the official record.
Environments.DataBoundary: Simulator-first, mock-data-first, and local-validation-first. No PHI, company production data, or real regulated production integration is authorized by this register.
Environments.MaturityStatement: Environment registration is not implementation proof, production readiness, regulatory validation, or operational release.
